SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM renumber_plan p LEFT JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id = p.id AND a."lawName" = p.law AND a."articleNumber" = p.current_number AND a."articleBis" = 0 WHERE a.id IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_rows
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام الإجراءات الجزائية') = 181 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام الرهن التجاري') = 47 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام الطيران المدني') = 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام براءات الاختراع والتصميمات التخطيطية للدارات المتكاملة والأصناف النباتية والنماذج الصناعية') = 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام مراقبة شركات التأمين التعاوني') = 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'النظام الموحد بشأن المواد المستنفدة لطبقة الأوزون لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية (المعدل)') = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام مكافحة غسل الأموال') = 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'قواعد تحديد أتعاب الخبراء والأمناء في نظام الإفلاس') = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_count
UPDATE legal_articles a SET "articleNumber" = a."articleNumber" + 100000 FROM renumber_plan p WHERE a.id = p.id
UPDATE legal_articles a SET "articleNumber" = p.new_number FROM renumber_plan p WHERE a.id = p.id AND a."articleNumber" >= 100000
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM renumber_plan p JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id = p.id WHERE a."articleNumber" <> p.new_number) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_after
